newsitem.title: UK: Singapore Airlines gets best of the year award.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Airlines gets best of the year award.

text.p: Singapore Airlines (SIA) was voted Airline of the Year, while American Airlines won the award for top U.S. domestic carrier, the magazine Executive Travel said Thursday.

SIA, which finished ahead of Dubai government-owned Emirates airline and Hong Kong's Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd., also won the categories for best airline to the Far East, top long-haul carrier, best ground and check-in and best airport lounges.

There are 27 categories in the magazine's annual poll and British Airways Plc collected the highest number of awards with 11. These included best airline to Africa and best to the Caribbean, Central and South America.
Among the six awards won by Virgin Group's Virgin Atlantic was the best long-haul business class and best in-flight entertainment.
UAL Corp.'s United Airlines was voted best trans-Atlantic carrier. American Airlines is a unit of AMR Corp.
Swissair, last year's overall winner, was voted best First Class cabin and best short-haul business class.
The award is voted by the magazine's 48,000 readers and by its 2,500-member Travel Check team, which monitors the world's leading airlines on quality of service.
